steps.content: [2026 Newcastle lord mayoral by-election] A by-election was held on 18 April 2026 to elect the lord mayor of the City of Newcastle. The vacancy was triggered by the resignation of Lord Mayor Ross Kerridge to focus on his health. Independent candidate Gavin Morris was elected in a landslide with over 67% of the two-candidate preferred vote. | other articles: List of mayors and lord mayors of Newcastle, City of Newcastle
